videoName: Capital Q flagship — Capital Q (AI presenter)
tone: Restrained, institutional, unhurried. No hype words; pauses before 'It is not a prediction'.
script: Hello. I'm an AI presenter, introducing Capital Q. Private capital still runs on scattered decks, partial information and long email threads. Capital Q is an investment intelligence system built around one analyst, called Q. For investors, Q helps you understand a company from its own materials, and shows where each point comes from and how well it is supported. It matches opportunities to your declared mandate, with reasons you can inspect. And it helps you progress qualified relationships, from first interest to diligence, while every commercial decision stays with you. Founders upload what they already have, and Q shows what is still missing. Unicorn Potential is an evidence-based indicator of what the record supports today. It is not a prediction, and where evidence is thin, it says so. Capital Q. Evidence before opinion.
